hi.intro: अर्जुन ने कई रास्ते देखे हैं। अब कृष्ण ज्ञान के रास्ते की बात करते हैं। सुनिए, वे कितने तरीकों से खुद को जानने की बात कहते हैं।
hi.meaning: दूसरे साधक ज्ञानयज्ञके द्वारा एकीभावसे अभेदभावसे मेरा पूजन करते हुए मेरी उपासना करते हैं और दूसरे कई साधक अपनेको पृथक् मानकर चारों तरफ मुखवाले मेरे विराट्ररुपकी अर्थात् संसारको मेरा विराट्ररुप मानकर सेव्यसेवकभावसे मेरी अनेक प्रकारसे उपासना करते हैं ॥
hi.next: कृष्ण अब कहते हैं कि वे ही यज्ञ हैं, वे ही वेदमंत्र हैं और वे ही इस संसार का बीज हैं।

en.intro: Arjuna has watched Krishna teach many paths. Now Krishna names the path of understanding. Listen for how many ways he says a person can know him.
en.body: Others worship Me through the sacrifice of knowledge, seeing Me as one, as separate, or as the all-facing form. The word ananye, others, tells us that Krishna is adding another kind of worshipper to the list, one who comes not with flowers but with understanding. Krishna now speaks of the all-facing form, the one who sees everything at once.

issues: meaning_changed: "कृष्ण अब उस विश्वरूप की बात करते हैं जो सब ओर एक साथ देख सकता है।" (The Hindi meaning of the verse itself describes two distinct groups of worshippers (one seeing oneness/non-difference, and another seeing separateness/the universal form). The Hindi intro/notice and the next description incorrectly merge these into a single 'all-facing form' (विश्वरूप), which contradicts the source's meaning of two different ways of seeing (one and separate) and completely ignores the first group of worshippers who see oneness (एकीभाव/अभेदभाव). The NEXT description in the script also misdescribes the next verse (16), which is about Krishna being the sacrifice/ritual/Om, not about the all-facing form.)

meaning_changed: "दूसरे साधक ज्ञानयज्ञके द्वारा एकीभावसे अभेदभावसे मेरा पूजन करते हुए मेरी उपासना करते हैं और दूसरे कई साधक अपनेको पृथक् मानकर चारों तरफ मुखवाले मेरे विराट्ररुपकी अर्थात् संसारको मेरा विराट्ररुप मानकर सेव्यसेवकभावसे मेरी अनेक प्रकारसे उपासना करते हैं" (The Hindi translation incorrectly splits the verse into two distinct groups of worshippers: (1) those seeing Krishna as one/non-different, and (2) those seeing him as separate/all-facing. The Sanskrit word 'anye' (others) applies to the first clause, but the Hindi translation makes it sound like a completely different group of people ('दूसरे कई साधक') are worshipping the all-facing form. The English source meaning correctly groups all 'others' as worshipping through the sacrifice of knowledge, seeing him as one, as separate, or as the all-facing form.)

borrowed: "कृष्ण अब कहते हैं कि वे ही यज्ञ हैं, वे ही वेदमंत्र हैं और वे ही इस संसार का बीज हैं।" (This phrase is taken from the content of the NEXT verse (9.16) and incorrectly presented as the 'next' part of this verse's notice. The 'next' field should describe the transition to verse 16, not quote the content of verse 16 itself.)
